title: Blow-up integrals over a locally Hⁿ-finite set are continuous in the centre
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be any set such that Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with compact support, and let r > 0. Put η_{x,r}(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (SimonGMT Chapter03.blowUpMap x r). Then x ↦ ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ, the integral of f against Hⁿ⌞η_{x,r}(M), is a continuous function on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Continuous (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n])
